lines.en: Who sold the story to Archie Comics?
Oh, my God! That's so great! Oh, wow!
- I wish I had a present for you. - Uh-huh.
My last kid can't get more.
- You want to share it? - Okay!
Hey, Janet, look, I know you're mad,
but I just want to say I'm sorry.
I was a total jerk, completely over the line.
I just... I hate pulp, you know?
I mean, you know how Monica feels about low-fat mayonnaise?
